units: relative layout units, not recovered measurements or Minecraft game coordinates
orientation: North up. +X east/right, +Y south/down on plan; floorLevel illustrative gradual relative descent.

nodes.name: Root mouth
nodes.features: Broad root arch, forked pale root on south jamb; flowering shrub above. Daylight west.
nodes.landmark: One fallen lilac blossom; M1 after day2.

nodes.name: Daylight fern lobby
nodes.features: Main family station. Ferns south; picnic alcove northwest; dry walkway centre; stream along north wall.
nodes.landmark: Left entrance, right inner arch; flat pale boulder at C2 arch.

nodes.name: Glowberry gallery
nodes.features: Amber berry vines suspended north wall; lower quiet nave, not another round entrance room.
nodes.landmark: Twin hanging roots at south entry; westward entrance glow behind cast.

nodes.name: Echo pool
nodes.features: Taller domed vault; shallow pool to north/east, broad dry south bank; filtered daylight shaft at north rim.
nodes.landmark: Pale crescent pool rim and smooth concave amber ceiling; audible echo.

nodes.name: Two-stream fork
nodes.features: One fixed root divides shallow stream A/B; firm bank south; children observe both runs.
nodes.landmark: M2 on dry-side forked root; slow eddy on stream B, no waterfall.

nodes.name: Blossom room
nodes.features: Large light-filled chamber, lilac hanging blossom at north skylight, fern/moss islands around clay pools.
nodes.landmark: Two streams reunite under root rib west of one flat retrieval stone; scent/damp clay causes dog curiosity.

nodes.name: Daylight outlet
nodes.features: Open natural arch to forest; outlet stream leaves southeast, dry walkway alongside.
nodes.landmark: M3 on pale leaning root; wet clay bank OUTSIDE to south causes final scratching/roll.

nodes.name: Fern/root glade
nodes.features: Discovery foreground; house is distant and never directly behind cave.

nodes.name: Outer forest path
nodes.features: Visible route around hill connecting two natural openings.

nodes.name: Chosen shower tree
nodes.features: Outside by west glade, no natural infinite shower. One low branch source; dry-side northwest, mat southeast, runoff southeast away from C0.

nodes.name: Outlet stream
nodes.features: Beaver beside outdoor stream; route to lake.

nodes.name: Known lake
nodes.features: Previously established lake/ducks; not a cave underground pool.

nodes.name: Forest fork
nodes.features: Spring branch west; cave path north; home south-west.

nodes.name: Known stone spring
nodes.features: Rabbit/PinPin day1 game and two canonical birds.

nodes.name: Cottage
nodes.features: Green front door; exterior and interior derived from published references, not this cave map.

sightLines: C0 sees C1 daylight floor, not blossom room or lake
C1 sees C2 arch and limited berries, not C3 pool
C2 reveals C3 dome only after north bend
C3 sees C4 stream lip, not C6 daylight directly
C4 sees flower-lit C5 arch; root rib occludes stream B briefly
C5 sees daylight at C6; leaf retrieval is on broad bank
Both openings connected outdoors by F2; Mama/PomPom do not teleport through scouting route
